source.name: Cboe delayed quotes
source.note: Open interest is the exchange's latest published value; intraday volume is partial.

method.max_pain: For every listed strike, sum intrinsic payout at that settlement: calls OI × max(0, S−K) + puts OI × max(0, K−S), times 100. Minimum wins.
method.blend: Open interest + 0.5 × session volume, per side.
method.shelf: Strikes whose total payout is within 1% of the minimum.
method.one_sigma: Spot × ATM IV × sqrt(DTE / 365). ATM IV is the mean of the nearest-strike call and put IVs.
method.risk_reversal: 25-delta put IV minus 25-delta call IV, in volatility points.
method.gex: Black-Scholes gamma at each hypothetical spot × OI × 100 × S² × 0.01; calls positive, puts negative.
method.gamma_flip: Nearest modeled zero crossing of net GEX within ±15% of spot.
method.pin_confidence: High if the OI, volume, and blend max pains are within 0.5% of spot; Moderate within 1%; otherwise Low.
